sections.st: Syringe Trays Manufacturer India — Pharma-Grade PETG, GMP Cleanroom · Vapi
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures syringe trays and holders from our Cleanroom Class 8, GMP-compliant, ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom PETG thermoformed syringe trays for prefilled syringes (PFS), empty syringes, and combination syringe packaging. Syringe packaging manufacturer from Vapi for pharmaceutical companies, contract filling organisations, and syringe manufacturers. As a syringe trays manufacturer from India, we supply PETG pharma-grade syringe trays for domestic pharmaceutical and for export.

Syringe tray packaging is a precision pharmaceutical application — prefilled syringes (PFS) contain the drug product in the primary container and must be handled with the same care as a finished pharmaceutical dosage form. The thermoformed PETG tray must support the syringe flange, protect the needle tip and needle shield, protect the plunger rod back-end from pre-actuation, and maintain the PFS in an upright, label-visible orientation for automated inspection and dispensing.

strips.title: Plunger Back-End Pre-Actuation — Prefilled Syringe Dose Displacement
strips.desc: Problem: Syringe tray packaging where any cavity contact pre-actuates the plunger stopper back-end displaces the PFS fill volume — the dose accuracy is compromised before the PFS reaches the patient. Solution: Plunger back-face clearance zone in all PFS tray designs — no packaging contact on the plunger stopper back face.

strips.title: Flange Support — Syringe Flange Must Bear Stack Load Without Breakage
strips.desc: Problem: Prefilled syringes with unsupported flanges under pallet stack loads experience flange breakage — flange breakage is a pharmaceutical primary container breach. Solution: Flange support ledge geometry in PETG syringe tray — the syringe flange rests on the tray ledge, transferring stack load through the tray structure rather than through the glass barrel.

strips.title: Needle Shield Contamination — Tip Cap Must Not Contact Tray Material
strips.desc: Problem: Syringe needle tip caps or needle shields that contact tray material may have drug contact surface contamination if the needle cap is breached. Solution: Needle cap clearance in all syringe tray designs — needle tip area suspended in clearance zone.

strips.desc: Syringe flange support ledge geometry designed from the specific PFS flange diameter and thickness. Stack load transferred through tray structure — glass barrel not subjected to compressive stack load.

strips.title: Needle Shield Clearance — Tip Cap No-Contact Zone
strips.desc: Needle cap and needle shield area suspended in clearance zone in all syringe tray cavity designs — no packaging contact on needle cap surfaces.
